blurb: Brochelle Vineyards produces wines from a steep hillside vineyard using minimal intervention and old-world techniques to highlight the fruit's origin. They offer events such as a Winemaker's Dinner and weekly summer glass specials. Guests can enjoy wine tastings and snacks at the vineyard without reservations during summer Thursdays.
